outline: 本課程幫助學生習得敘述、描寫、推論、議論、省思、說明等文體方面的寫作技巧，並指導學生從閱讀、圖片、日常生活事件，及課堂討論內容中取材，以加強邏輯思考和流暢寫作能力。
schedule:
Week 1	2/20	Course Introduction
Week 2	2/27	Essay Writing: Cause and Effect
Week 3	3/6	Essay Writing: Cause and Effect cont.
Week 4	3/13	Essay Writing: Cause and Effect cont.
Week 5	3/20	T-Unit
Week 6	3/27	T-Unit cont.
Week 7	4/3	Essay Writing: Argumentative
Week 8	4/10	Essay Writing: Argumentative cont.
Week 9	4/17	Essay Writing: Argumentative cont.
Week 10	4/24	Readability
Week 11	5/1	Readability cont.
Week 12	5/8	Readability cont.
Week 13	5/15	Essay Writing: Comparison & Contrast
Weel 14	5/22	Essay Writing: Comparison & Contrast cont.
Week 15	5/29	Essay Writing: Comparison & Contrast cont.
Week 16	6/5	TBA
Week 17	6/12	TBA
Week 18	6/19	Final Exam Week
assessment: Attendance & Participation (15%); Individual Presentation (10%); Peer Writing Evaluation (15%); Pop Quizzes (10%); Writing Assignments (50%).
materials:
